scripts.build:preview: pnpm --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-webworker-runtime exec tsdown && pnpm --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-webworker-packer exec tsdown && vite build && dsh-pack-vfs-image --out dist/preview/vfs-image.tar.gz

scripts.build:lib: npm run build:lib:host && npm run build:lib:client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:lib:host && npm run typecheck:contracts-ready
scripts.lint: npm run build:lib:host && npm run lint:contracts-ready
scripts.lint:fix: npm run build:lib:host && npm run lint:fix:contracts-ready
scripts.test:web: npm run build && npm run test:web:built
scripts.test:web:refresh: npm run build && DSH_SNAPSHOT=refresh vitest run --config vitest.web.config.ts
scripts.test:web:perf: npm run build && npm run test:web:perf:built
scripts.test:web:stress: npm run build && vitest run --config vitest.web-stress.config.ts
scripts.doc-typecheck: npm run build:lib:host && npm run doc-typecheck:contracts-ready
scripts.docs:check: pnpm exec vitest run scripts/project-doc-site.spec.ts scripts/verify-doc-site-fragments.spec.ts && pnpm run docs:build
